description_en: Gets a list of layer versions
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open list-layer-versions --layer-name MyLayer --start-version 1 --limit 20 --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id rid281s000000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLayerVersions

parameters.help_en: The layer name. You can query only custom layer versions. You cannot query versions of official public layers
parameters.help_zh: 层的名称。仅支持查询自定义层版本，不支持查询官方公共层版本
parameters.name: layer_name

parameters.help_en: The initial version of the layer
parameters.name: start_version

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. Default value: 20. The value cannot exceed 100. The number of returned configurations is less than or equal to the specified number
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the operation is called. The format is: EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: API调用时间，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id
